How many themes are free, and what does Premium unlock?

The free version includes 5 of the 101 themes, 2 lists with up to 4 tasks each and 1 emoji set. Premium, a one-time in-app purchase, unlocks all 101 themes (96 more), unlimited lists and tasks, and all 11 emoji sets, according to the App Store listing.
Does the unlock transfer if I get a new iPhone?
Yes. Premium is a one-time in-app purchase, so it can be restored at no extra charge on a new iPhone signed in to the same Apple ID.
Are there any features behind a separate paywall beyond Premium?
No. Mochi has no subscription; its only purchase is the one-time Premium unlock, which covers unlimited lists and tasks, all 101 themes and all 11 emoji sets.
